give me 10 different and very interesting  short psychological story ideas for backrooms videos. an example that was really good is someone stuck in an infinite grocery store and then when they try to escape through the front door (it’s locked), a big monster is released. make sure it makes sense for the main character to have a camera. try not to have more than the main character.
